dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Smoothly concave trailing edge curve extending from the rounded apex to the posterior insertion point on the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Medium pixel radius with a rounded shape classification.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 40-degree posterior incline relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.2:1 ratio of base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius convex arc with a gradual transition from the blowhole region to the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, blunt rostrum with a high thickness-to-length pixel ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Highly obtuse angle at the transition point where the melon slope meets the dorsal rostrum margin.
